Fields.Name: Start State
Fields.Description: The state the state machine starts in.

Fields.Name: Return To Previous State Event
Fields.Description: The event that returns to the previous state. -1 for none.

Fields.Name: Random Transition Event
Fields.Description: The event that moves to a random state. -1 for none.

Fields.Name: Next Higher State Event
Fields.Description: The event that moves to the state with the next higher state ID. -1 for none.

Fields.Name: Next Lower State Event
Fields.Description: The event that moves to the state with the next lower state ID. -1 for none.

Fields.Name: Sync Variable
Fields.Description: The variable the current state ID is written to. -1 for none.
